text: DBIM SCHEME PAGES COVER EVERY SECTION OF THE SCHEME DETAILS TEMPLATE, IN THE DBIM LAYOUT. The right column now reads About the Scheme · Eligibility · Benefits & Financial Assistance · Application Process · Documents · FAQs · Contact & Support · Sources — the Department's own section where its page publishes one, the scheme master's where it does not, nothing invented. The rail keeps the reference's shape: the VISIT bar now names where it goes, and How to Apply lists only the routes the bar does not open, so no two controls lead to the same portal. The VISIT bar moves from primary-400 to primary-200, as primary-800 text on 400 measured below 4.5:1.
